environment.cpu_note: hybrid: 8 P-cores (2 threads each) + 12 E-cores, 20 physical cores / 28 logical; OMP_PLACES=cores with OMP_PROC_BIND=close puts thread k on its own physical core (1-8: the P-cores, 9-20: add E-cores); no SMT sibling is used (checked with sched_getcpu)
environment.host: Intel Core i7-14700KF desktop (20 cores: 8 P + 12 E, 30 GB), AVX2 (no AVX-512), RHEL 10.2, intel_pstate powersave governor, turbo on; NVIDIA RTX 4060 present but not used by these benchmarks

run_env.runs_serialised: one benchmark at a time, no other load

environment.source_commit: b65d700 (fix/native-aarch64; x86 flags unchanged from main)

definitions.operator_timing: apply_low wall time on a fixed float32 probe
definitions.high_operator_timing: apply_high wall time on a fixed float64 probe
definitions.construction_ms: native MatrixFreeThermalOperator construction wall time (FP64 coarse assembly and dense inverse included)
definitions.solver_timing: solve_mpir wall time; operator construction (27 FP64 applications and the dense coarse inverse) excluded and reported separately
definitions.speedup: portable NumPy median divided by native median
definitions.native_path: fused node-gather hex Q1 operator plus the whole inner PCG with the two-level preconditioner in one SPMD OpenMP region; FTZ/DAZ per thread
definitions.decision_threads: the first thread count in the sweep

decision.criteria: every case at least 2x faster end to end at the decision thread count, identical convergence outcome, converged solutions within 1e-6
